name: sign-guard
description: Spots Windows builds (cargo --release, dotnet publish, go build, pyinstaller, tauri, electron-builder, msbuild) and signs the new .exe/.msi/.msix with your own signing script.

mode.title: Sign Guard: mode
mode.description: ask: offer a sign button. auto: sign right away.

subject.title: Sign Guard: certificate
subject.description: Files already signed by a certificate whose subject contains this are skipped. Empty: any validly signed file is skipped.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
